newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lojas Arapua started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lojas Arapua started.

text.p: -- UBS Securities said it had started coverage of Brazilian retailer Lojas Arapua with a buy rating.

-- "Arapua is prepared for growth. We estimate its plans for sales area expansion and greater productivity will provide sustained earnings growth," analysts Julio Zamora and John McCormack wrote in a November 18 report.

-- "Arapua trades at a 33 percent discount to its peers and a 48 percent discount" to the Sao Paulo exchange. "Our 12-month price target is $32.70, based on a multiple of 10 times estimated 1997 earnings."
-- The preferred share closed at 17.10 reais on Monday in Sao Paulo.
